_about: Prices and payment links for /rain-print. The page reads this file; change a price here and the page follows. payment_links: paste a Stripe Payment Link (https://buy.stripe.com/...) per product. While a link is null, that button opens the order request form instead. The page adds client_reference_id=<design code> to the link, so each Stripe payment carries the design; open https://agsist.com/rain-print?d=<code> to see it.
ships_within: Printed posters ship rolled in a tube within 7 business days after you approve the proof. US addresses only for now.
